home.headline: Deniz Zeybek
home.intro: Most of my work has been analytics dashboards, a component library three products were rebuilt on, and a Vue 2 to Vue 3 migration that ran while the roadmap kept moving.
home.agents: Since 2025 I work with coding agents every day, and it changed how I set a project up before the first feature: a generated API client, a strict compiler, and conventions written where an agent can read them.
home.nda: Almost everything I have shipped sits behind an NDA, so there is no gallery here. What I think is in the {notes}.
home.roleLine: Software developer, mainly frontend — TypeScript across the stack, six years shipping production web apps at enterprise scale.
home.facts: I am based in Turkey on GMT+3 and work remotely only, worldwide or across EMEA, contract or full-time. Computer Engineering degree from Muğla University, professional English, native Turkish. Deepest on Vue 3, Nuxt and TypeScript; hands-on with React and React Native; comfortable owning the Node and NestJS side of a feature rather than handing it over at the API.

insiderone.summary: Full-stack feature work on an AI-powered customer engagement platform, across a microfrontend and microservices architecture.
highlights: Architected and shipped a greenfield rewrite of a core analytics dashboard in TypeScript and the Composition API, built around composables.
Built real-time campaign data-visualisation components, and an internal npm package for a shared filter system, developed test-first.
Built an LLM-powered Figma-to-code plugin that turns designs into design-system components, with Playwright visual verification and self-healing fixes.
Configured Webpack Module Federation for the Vue microfrontends, and the GitHub Actions pipelines that test and deploy them.
Introduced the agentic workflow the team now uses: shared conventions, custom skills and TDD guardrails for coding agents.

ruul.summary: Product work on Vue and Nuxt, and the shared frontend foundation three products were rebuilt on.
highlights: Led the migration from Vue 2 to the Vue 3 Composition API with TypeScript, without stopping feature delivery.
Architected a reusable UI component library of 50+ components, adopted across three products.
Moved state management from Vuex to Pinia, cutting roughly a third of the boilerplate.
Turned Figma designs into responsive, pixel-accurate interfaces with Tailwind CSS and Ant Design Vue.
Drove architectural decisions and sprint planning in a cross-functional agile team.

eclone.summary: Full-stack work for enterprise clients, from gathering the requirement to shipping it.
highlights: Built and deployed full-stack web applications with Vue on the frontend and a backend I owned myself.
Designed and maintained SQL Server databases, and optimised the queries behind the APIs.
Worked directly with clients to turn business needs into something that could be built.

blog.headline: What I think about building frontends, written down.
blog.intro: Migrations, design systems, architecture boundaries, and working with coding agents. No client work and no screenshots — the reasoning is the part that travels.
